in_hindi.name: विजयसिंह
in_hindi.meaning: विजय (vijaya) = विजयित (vijayit) = to conquer, सिंह (singh) = शिवालय पति (shivalaya pati) = lord of Shiva
in_hindi.long_meaning: The lord of victory and Shiva, or the conquering one of Shiva

in_marathi.name: Vijaysingh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vijaysingh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vijay (Victory) + Singh (Lion)

in_bengali.name: Vijaysingh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Victorious Lion
